designationHistory.indexText: National Wildlife Refuge Swan Quarter, NC Swanquarter National Wildlife Refuge Swanquarter National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1932 and protects an extensive coastal brackish marsh on Pamlico Sound in Hyde County, North Carolina.
